AprilKnights (order 170, contrary room) read whole (161 lines, 12 themes, every concept) and placed, all 12. Three new kinds, minted before the room's other placements: T3-171 spreading a colour over the canvas (trigger t03: Spread the Red with the Red Corner, a colour field as the work itself; t03 is a bag kept there; greenlattice's lattice, cirkeltrek's orange and the colour corners still to come are the same doing, for the second pass and the rooms ahead), T3-172 renewing the order's oaths (trigger t05: a standing order from the 2015 Button event reconvening, oaths sworn, new Knights welcomed, also in T3-044), T3-173 holding elections for office (trigger t09: candidacies, voter registration and elections moved after the event; T3-101 putting one member in charge and T3-066 putting a decision to the room were weighed and set aside, since neither holds offices filled by election). Two bags: t03 kept in T3-171, t04 in T3-150 (truces, moves agreed, an attack refused because the mission is peace for all colours, c0047, wanting T3-138). The anti-Blue title answered with carrots (t11) in T3-006. Episode E074 with jerma985. 8 rule 0 lines and two bags.
